about: kc.receipt.* keys from karmicare/soft-launch-pdp (c7819e1), in the entry format of docs/localization/theme-keys.json. When locales/*.json conflict on merge: take the integration side, append these entries to theme-keys.json "keys", run python3 docs/localization/theme_keys.py write. The ids are the baseline (3bae259) lines that held the English; they are not in the B1a inventory yet.
